read.en: Alphabet rose 2.1% on Nov 11 to $293.45, trading $289.48–295.74 on light volume (0.62x the 20-day average). It is above the rising 5-day ($287.3) and the 10-day ($284.8) and below the 30-day ($321.5), 100-day ($339.4) and 200-day ($338.9), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($277.69), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月11日上涨 2.1%，收于 $293.45，盘中区间 $289.48–295.74，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.62 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$287.3）和 10 日均线（$284.8）上方，30 日（$321.5）、100 日（$339.4）和 200 日均线（$338.9）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$277.69），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The close cleared the $290.5–292 resistance (Nov 6 and Nov 10 highs), now support, but the $295.74 high stayed under $296.3–296.5 (Nov 9 and Nov 4 highs). Resistance is $294.1–296.5, then $300 and $314.9 (Jul 23 low). Support is $287.3–292 (5-day, Nov 11 low), then $283.4–285.7 (10-day, Nov 4 and Nov 10 lows) and $277–277.7 (SAR). A close above $296.5 would target $300; below $287.3, $283–286.
